translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Western Wei made Prince Fu of Fufeng Grand Protector, Liang Jingrui Grand Tutor, Prince Zan of Guangping Grand Commandant, and Wang Meng of Wuchuan Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 東魏丞相歡游汾陽之天池，得奇石，隱起成文曰「六王三川」。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Chancellor Huan toured the Heavenly Pool at Fenyang and obtained a strange stone with characters standing out in relief: "Six Kings Three Rivers."
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan visited the Heavenly Pool at Fenyang and found a stone marked "Six Kings Three Rivers."

sentences.zh: 以問行台郎中陽休之，對曰：「六者，大王之字；

translations.literal: He asked Mobile Headquarters Gentleman Yang Xiuzhi; he answered, "Six is the character for great king; king means to rule all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He asked Yang Xiuzhi. Xiuzhi said, "Six reads as the character for great king; a king rules the realm.

sentences.zh: 王者，當王天下。

translations.literal: The He, Luo, and Yi are the three rivers; the Jing, Wei, and Luo are also three rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The He, Luo, and Yi are three rivers; so are the Jing, Wei, and Luo.

sentences.zh: 河、洛、伊為三川，涇、渭、洛亦為三川。

translations.literal: If the great king receives Heaven's mandate, in the end he should possess Guan and Luo."
translations.idiomatic: Take Heaven's mandate and you will hold Guan and Luo at last."

sentences.zh: 大王若受天命，終應奄有關、洛。

translations.literal: Huan said, "People idle talk that I rebel—how much more if they hear this!
translations.idiomatic: Huan said, "Men already call me a rebel—must this be added to their gossip!

sentences.zh: 」歡曰：「世人無事常言我反，況聞此乎！

translations.literal: Take care not to speak rashly!"
translations.idiomatic: Hold your tongue!"

sentences.zh: 慎勿妄言！

translations.literal: Xiuzhi was Gu's son.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuzhi was Gu's son.

sentences.zh: 」休之，固之子也。

translations.literal: Mobile Headquarters Gentleman Du Bi of Zhongshan seized the moment to urge Huan to accept the abdication; Huan raised a staff and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Du Bi of Zhongshan pressed him to take the throne; Huan beat him away with a staff.

sentences.zh: 行台郎中中山杜弼承間勸歡受禪，歡舉杖擊走之。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei sent Associate Bearer of the Staff Li Xie as envoy on a friendly mission, with Director of Personnel Lu Yuanming and Attendant Gentleman Li Yexing as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei sent Li Xie as envoy, with Lu Yuanming and Li Yexing as deputies.

sentences.zh: 東魏遣兼散騎常侍李諧來聘，以吏部郎盧元明、通直侍郎李業興副之。

translations.literal: Xie was Ping's grandson;
translations.idiomatic: Xie was grandson of Ping;

sentences.zh: 諧，平之孫；

translations.literal: Yuanming was Chang's son.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanming was Chang's son.

sentences.zh: 元明，昶之子也。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Xie and the rest reached Jiankang; the emperor received them and conversed; their replies flowed like water.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, they reached Jiankang. The emperor received them; their answers ran like water.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，諧等至建康，上引見，與語，應對如流。

translations.literal: When Xie and the rest went out, the emperor watched them leave and told those at his side, "Today I have met a formidable foe.
translations.idiomatic: When they withdrew, the emperor watched them go and told his attendants, "Today I met a formidable match.

sentences.zh: 諧等出，上目送之，謂左右曰：「朕今日遇勍敵。

translations.literal: You all used to say the north had no men at all—where did these come from!"
translations.idiomatic: You kept saying the north had no talent—whence these men!"

sentences.zh: 卿輩嘗言北間全無人物，此等何自而來！

translations.literal: At the time in Ye those famed for refinement named Li Xie, Li Shenjun of Longxi, Lu Yuanming of Fanyang, Wang Yuanjing of Beihai, Yang Zunyan of Hongnong, and Cui Zhan of Qinghe as the leaders.
translations.idiomatic: In Ye the leaders of fashion were Li Xie, Li Shenjun of Longxi, Lu Yuanming of Fanyang, Wang Yuanjing of Beihai, Yang Zunyan of Hongnong, and Cui Zhan of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 」是時鄴下言風流者，以諧及隴西李神俊、范陽盧元明、北海王元景、弘農楊遵彥、清河崔贍為首。

translations.literal: Shenjun's given name was Ting; he was Bao's grandson;
translations.idiomatic: Shenjun styled Ting and was Bao's grandson;

sentences.zh: 神俊名挺，寶之孫；

translations.literal: Yuanjing's given name was Xin; he was Xian's great-grandson;
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjing styled Xin and was Xian's great-grandson;

sentences.zh: 元景名昕，憲之曾孫也；

translations.literal: all went by their courtesy names.
translations.idiomatic: all used their styles.

sentences.zh: 皆以字行。

translations.literal: Zhan was Ling's son.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan was Ling's son.

sentences.zh: 贍，凌之子也。

translations.literal: North and south were on good terms and each boasted of its eminent men; those who bore credentials and received guests had to be the finest of the age—men without talent or standing could not take part.
translations.idiomatic: Peace let north and south parade their best men; envoys had to be the flower of the age—no talent, no mission.

sentences.zh: 時南、北通好，務以俊乂相誇，銜命接客，必盡一時之選，無才地者不得與焉。

translations.literal: Whenever a Liang envoy reached Ye, Ye was stirred by it; sons of the great dressed up and gathered to watch; gifts and courtesy were lavish and the inns became a market.
translations.idiomatic: Each Liang embassy set Ye abuzz; noble youths turned out in splendor; gifts piled up until the guesthouses seemed a fair.

sentences.zh: 每梁使至鄴，鄴下為之傾動，貴勝子弟盛飾聚觀，禮贈優渥，館門成市。

translations.literal: On the day of the banquet, Gao Cheng often had his attendants observe them; one winning phrase and Cheng would clap his hands in delight.
translations.idiomatic: At the feast Gao Cheng posted watchers; one sharp line and he clapped aloud.

sentences.zh: 宴日，高澄常使左右覘之，一言制勝，澄為之拊掌。

translations.literal: When Wei envoys reached Jiankang it was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei envoys were received the same way at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 魏使至建康亦然。

translations.literal: Dugu Xin asked to return north, and the emperor permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Dugu Xin asked leave to go north, and the Liang emperor consented.

sentences.zh: 獨孤信求還北，上許之。

translations.literal: Xin's father and mother were both in Shandong; the emperor asked Xin where he was going, and Xin said, "One who serves his lord dare not look to private kin and harbor divided loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: His parents were still in the east. Asked his route, Xin said, "A servant of his prince does not weigh kin against duty."

sentences.zh: 信父母皆在山東，上問信所適，信曰：「事君者不敢顧私親而懷貳心。

translations.literal: " The emperor thought this righteous and saw him off with thick gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor called it righteous and sent him away with rich gifts.

sentences.zh: 」上以為義，禮送甚厚。

translations.literal: Xin and Yang Zhong both reached Chang'an and submitted memorials of apology.
translations.idiomatic: Xin and Yang Zhong reached Chang'an and apologized at court.

sentences.zh: 信與楊忠皆至長安，上書謝罪。

translations.literal: Xin and Yang Zhong both reached Chang'an and submitted memorials of apology.
translations.idiomatic: Xin and Yang Zhong reached Chang'an and apologized at court.

sentences.zh: 魏以信有定三荊之功，遷驃騎大將軍，加侍中、開府儀同三司，餘官爵如故。

translations.literal: Wei, because Xin had secured the three Jing provinces, promoted him to Cavalry Grand General, added Palace Attendant and Bearer of the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes, and left his other offices and titles as before.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei, honoring his conquest of the three Jing provinces, made him Cavalry Grand General with Palace Attendant and the rank of Bearer of the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes, leaving his other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 丞相泰愛楊忠之勇，留置帳下。

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai loved Yang Zhong's courage and kept him in his tent.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai prized Yang Zhong's valor and kept him in his guard.

sentences.zh: 魏宇文深勸丞相泰取恆農。

translations.literal: Yuwen Shen urged Chancellor Tai to take Hengnong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Shen urged Tai to seize Hengnong.

sentences.zh: 八月，丁丑，泰帥李弼等十二將伐東魏，以北雍州刺史於謹為前鋒，攻盤豆，拔之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingchou, Tai led Li Bi and twelve other generals against Eastern Wei, making Yu Jin of Northern Yongzhou vanguard; they attacked Pándòu and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou, Tai led Li Bi and twelve generals against Eastern Wei with Yu Jin of Northern Yongzhou in the van; they stormed Pándòu and took it.

sentences.zh: 戊子，至恆農。

translations.literal: On wuzi they reached Hengnong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi they reached Hengnong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，拔之，擒東魏陝州刺史李徽伯，俘其戰士八千。

translations.literal: On gengyin they took it, captured Li Huibo, Eastern Wei's inspector of Shaan, and took eight thousand fighting men prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin they stormed the city, seized Li Huibo, inspector of Shaan, and eight thousand soldiers.

sentences.zh: 時河北諸城多附東魏，左丞楊檦自言父猛嘗為邵郡白水令，知其豪傑，請往說之，以取邵郡；

translations.literal: At the time most cities north of the river still sided with Eastern Wei; Left Director Yang Biao said his father Meng had once been magistrate of Baishui in Shao commandery and knew the local magnates, and asked to go persuade them and take Shao commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Most Hebei towns still held for Eastern Wei. Yang Biao, Left Director, said his father Meng had governed Baishui in Shao and knew the great families, and asked leave to win Shao;

sentences.zh: 泰許之。

translations.literal: Tai permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Tai agreed.

sentences.zh: 檦乃與土豪王覆憐等舉兵，收邵郡守程保及縣令四人，斬之，表覆憐為郡守，遣諜說諭東魏城堡，旬月之間，歸附甚眾。

translations.literal: Biao then with the magnate Wang Fuqian and others raised troops, seized Cheng Bao, governor of Shao, and four county magistrates, beheaded them, memorialized Fuqian as governor, and sent agents to persuade Eastern Wei forts; within a month submission was very great.
translations.idiomatic: Biao and Wang Fuqian rose, seized Governor Cheng Bao and four county heads, executed them, made Fuqian governor, and sent agents among the eastern forts; within a month many submitted.

sentences.zh: 東魏以東雍州刺史司馬恭鎮正平，司空從事中郎聞喜裴邃欲攻之，恭棄城走，泰以楊□剽行正平郡事。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei made Sima Gong, Eastern Yongzhou inspector, guard Zhengping; Pei Sui, associate in the Ministry of Works, wished to attack him; Gong abandoned the city and fled; Tai made Yang [lacuna] acting governor of Zhengping commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei's Sima Gong held Zhengping; Pei Sui of the Ministry of Works moved to strike; Gong fled; Tai put Yang [?] in charge of Zhengping.

sentences.zh: 上修長干寺阿育王塔，出佛爪發捨利。

translations.literal: The emperor repaired the Ashoka pagoda at Changgan Temple and displayed the Buddha's nail and hair relics.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang emperor restored Ashoka's pagoda at Changgan Temple and displayed the Buddha's nail and hair relics.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上幸寺，設無礙食，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinmao the emperor visited the temple, set an unobstructed feast, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he visited the temple, gave a feast without restriction, and proclaimed amnesty.

sentences.zh: 九月，柔然為魏侵東魏三堆，丞相歡擊之，柔然退走。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Rouran, on Wei's behalf, raided Eastern Wei's Sanhui; Chancellor Huan struck them, and Rouran withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Rouran, aiding Western Wei, raided Eastern Wei's Sanhui; Gao Huan drove them off.

sentences.zh: 行台郎中杜弼以文武在位多貪污，言於丞相歡，請治之。

translations.literal: Du Bi, Gentleman-inside-the-Palace of the Mobile Headquarters, because many civil and military officials in office were corrupt, spoke to Chancellor Huan and asked that they be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Du Bi, Gentleman-inside-the-Palace of the Mobile Headquarters, because many civil and military officials in office were corrupt, spoke to Chancellor Gao Huan and asked that they be punished.

sentences.zh: 歡曰：「弼來，我語爾！

translations.literal: Huan said, "Bi has come—I will speak to you!
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan said, "Bi has come—I will speak to you!

sentences.zh: 天下貪污習俗已久。

translations.literal: The custom of corruption under Heaven is of long standing.
translations.idiomatic: The custom of corruption under Heaven is of long standing, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 今督將家屬多在關西，宇文黑獺常相招誘，人情去留未定；

translations.literal: Now the families of commanders and generals are mostly in Guanxi; Yuwen the Black Badger constantly entices them, and men's hearts are unsettled whether to stay or go;
translations.idiomatic: Now the families of commanders and generals are mostly in Guanxi; Yuwen the Black Badger constantly entices them, and men's hearts are unsettled whether to stay or go, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 江東復有一吳翁蕭衍，專事衣冠禮樂，中原士大夫望之以為正朔所在。

translations.literal: East of the river there is again the Old Man of Wu, Xiao Yan, who devotes himself to caps and robes, rites and music—the Central Plains gentry look to him as where the true succession lies.
translations.idiomatic: East of the river there is again the Old Man of Wu, Xiao Yan, who devotes himself to caps and robes, rites and music—the Central Plains gentry look to him as where the true succession lies.

sentences.zh: 我若急正綱紀，不相假借，恐督將盡歸黑獺，士子悉奔蕭衍。

translations.literal: If I urgently set right the statutes and show no indulgence, I fear commanders and generals will all go to the Black Badger and scholars all flee to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: If I urgently set right the statutes and show no indulgence, I fear commanders and generals will all go to the Black Badger and scholars all flee to Xiao Yan, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 人物流散，何以為國！

translations.literal: Men and goods scattered—how could one be a state!
translations.idiomatic: Men and goods scattered—how could one be a state!

sentences.zh: 爾宜少待，吾不忘之。

translations.literal: You ought to wait a little; I have not forgotten this.
translations.idiomatic: You ought to wait a little; I have not forgotten this, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 歡將出兵拒魏，杜弼請先除內賊。

translations.literal: Huan was about to lead troops to resist Wei; Du Bi asked first to remove the traitors within.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan was about to lead troops to resist Wei; Du Bi asked first to remove the traitors within.

sentences.zh: 歡問內賊為誰，弼曰：「諸勳貴掠奪百姓者是也。

translations.literal: Huan asked who the traitors within were; Bi said, "The meritorious nobles who plunder the common people are."
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan asked who the traitors within were; Bi said, "The meritorious nobles who plunder the common people are."

sentences.zh: 」歡不應，使軍士皆張弓注矢，舉刀，按槊，夾道羅列，命弼冒出其間，弼戰心栗流汗。

translations.literal: " Huan did not answer. He had the soldiers all draw bows with arrows nocked, raise blades, and press spears, arrayed in double files along the road, and ordered Bi to pass through among them; Bi's battle-heart trembled and he sweated.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Huan did not answer. He had the soldiers all draw bows with arrows nocked, raise blades, and press spears, arrayed in double files along the road, and ordered Bi to pass through among them; Bi's battle-heart trembled and he sweated.

sentences.zh: 歡乃徐諭之曰：「矢雖注不射，刀雖舉不擊，槊雖按不刺，爾猶亡魄失膽。

translations.literal: Huan then slowly instructed him, saying, "Though arrows are nocked they are not shot; though blades are raised they are not struck; though spears are pressed they are not thrust—yet you still lose soul and courage.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan then slowly instructed him, saying, "Though arrows are nocked they are not shot; though blades are raised they are not struck; though spears are pressed they are not thrust—yet you still lose soul and courage, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 諸勳人身犯鋒鏑，百死一生，雖或貪鄙，所取者大，豈可同之常人也！

translations.literal: The meritorious men personally face blades and arrows—a hundred deaths, one life. Though some may be greedy and base, what they take is great—how can they be classed with ordinary men!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, The meritorious men personally face blades and arrows—a hundred deaths, one life. Though some may be greedy and base, what they take is great—how can they be classed with ordinary men!"

sentences.zh: 」弼乃頓首謝不及。

translations.literal: " Bi then knocked his head and apologized that he had gone too far.
translations.idiomatic: " Bi then knocked his head and apologized that he had gone too far, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 歡每號令軍士，常令丞相屬代郡張華原宣旨，其語鮮卑則曰：「漢民是汝奴，夫為汝耕，婦為汝織，輸汝粟帛，令汝溫飽，汝何為陵之？

translations.literal: Whenever Huan issued orders to the soldiers, he always had Zhang Huayuan of Dai commandery, an aide in the Chancellor's Office, proclaim the intent. To Xianbei he said in their tongue, "Han people are your slaves: the men plow for you, the women weave for you, they deliver your grain and cloth and keep you warm and fed—why do you bully them?
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Gao Huan issued orders to the soldiers, he always had Zhang Huayuan of Dai commandery, an aide in the Chancellor's Office, proclaim the intent. To Xianbei he said in their tongue, "Han people are your slaves: the men plow for you, the women weave for you, they deliver your grain and cloth and keep you warm and fed—why do you bully them?

sentences.zh: 」其語華人則曰：「鮮卑是汝作客，得汝一斛粟、一匹絹，為汝擊賊，令汝安寧，汝何為疾之？

translations.literal: " To Chinese he said, "The Xianbei are your hired guests: for a hu of your grain and a bolt of your silk they fight your enemies and keep you at peace—why do you resent them?
translations.idiomatic: In sum, To Chinese he said, "The Xianbei are your hired guests: for a hu of your grain and a bolt of your silk they fight your enemies and keep you at peace—why do you resent them?"

sentences.zh: 時鮮卑共輕華人，唯憚高敖曹。

translations.literal: At that time the Xianbei together looked down on the Chinese; they feared only Gao Aocao.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Xianbei together looked down on the Chinese; they feared only Gao Aocao, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 歡號令將士，常鮮卑語，敖曹在列，則為之華言。

translations.literal: When Huan ordered officers and soldiers, he usually spoke Xianbei; if Aocao was present, he used Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan ordered officers and soldiers, he usually spoke Xianbei; if Aocao was present, he used Chinese.

sentences.zh: 敖曹返自上洛，歡復以為軍司、大都督，統七十六都督。

translations.literal: Aocao returned from Shangluo; Huan again made him Army Supervisor and Grand Commander, commanding seventy-six commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Aocao returned from Shangluo; Gao Huan again made him Army Supervisor and Grand Commander, commanding seventy-six commandants.

sentences.zh: 以司空侯景為西道大行台，與敖曹及行台任祥、御史中尉劉貴、豫州刺史堯雄、冀州刺史-{万俟}-洛同治兵於虎牢。

translations.literal: He made Minister of Works Hou Jing Western Route Mobile Headquarters, and together with Aocao, Mobile Headquarters Ren Xiang, Imperial Censor Liu Gui, Yuzhou inspector Yao Xiong, and Jizhou inspector Moqi Luo he drilled troops at Hulao.
translations.idiomatic: He made Minister of Works Hou Jing Western Route Mobile Headquarters, and together with Aocao, Mobile Headquarters Ren Xiang, Imperial Censor Liu Gui, Yuzhou inspector Yao Xiong, and Jizhou inspector Moqi Luo he drilled troops at Hulao.

sentences.zh: 敖曹與北豫州刺史鄭嚴祖握槊，貴召嚴祖，敖曹不時遣，枷其使者。

translations.literal: Aocao was playing pitch-pot with Northern Yuzhou inspector Zheng Yanzu; Gui summoned Yanzu, and Aocao did not send him at once but cangued the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Aocao was playing pitch-pot with Northern Yuzhou inspector Zheng Yanzu; Liu Gui summoned Yanzu, and Aocao did not send him at once but cangued the envoy.

sentences.zh: 使者曰：「枷則易，脫則難。

translations.literal: The envoy said, "Putting on the cangue is easy; taking it off is hard."
translations.idiomatic: The envoy said, "Putting on the cangue is easy; taking it off is hard."

sentences.zh: 」敖曹以刀就枷刎之，曰：「又何難！

translations.literal: Aocao brought a blade to the cangue and cut his throat, saying, "What is hard about that!"
translations.idiomatic: Aocao brought a blade to the cangue and cut his throat, saying, "What is hard about that!"

sentences.zh: 」貴不敢校。

translations.literal: " Gui did not dare contend.
translations.idiomatic: " Liu Gui did not dare contend, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 明日，貴與敖曹坐，外白治河役夫多溺死，貴曰：「一錢漢，隨之死！

translations.literal: The next day Gui and Aocao were seated when someone outside reported that many laborers on river works had drowned; Gui said, "A one-cash Han—let him die with them!"
translations.idiomatic: The next day Liu Gui and Aocao were seated when someone outside reported that many laborers on river works had drowned; Gui said, "A one-cash Han—let him die with them!"

sentences.zh: 」敖曹怒，拔刀斫貴；

translations.literal: Aocao grew angry, drew his blade, and hacked at Gui;
translations.idiomatic: Aocao grew angry, drew his blade, and hacked at Gui;

sentences.zh: 貴走出還營，敖曹鳴鼓會兵，欲攻之。

translations.literal: Gui ran out and returned to camp; Aocao beat the drums to assemble troops and was about to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Gui ran out and returned to camp; Aocao beat the drums to assemble troops and was about to attack him.

sentences.zh: 侯景、-{万俟}-洛共解諭，久之乃止。

translations.literal: Hou Jing and Moqi Luo together reasoned with him, and only after a long while did he stop.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing and Moqi Luo together reasoned with him, and only after a long while did he stop, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 敖曹嘗詣相府，門者不納，敖曹引弓射之，歡知而不責。

translations.literal: Aocao once went to the Chancellor's mansion; the gatekeeper would not admit him, so Aocao drew his bow and shot at him. Huan knew of it and did not blame him.
translations.idiomatic: Aocao once went to the Chancellor's mansion; the gatekeeper would not admit him, so Aocao drew his bow and shot at him. Gao Huan knew of it and did not blame him.

sentences.zh: 閏月，甲子，以武陵王紀為都督益、梁等十三州諸軍事、益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on jiazi, Prince Ji of Wuling was made Commander-in-Chief of military affairs for thirteen provinces including Yi and Liang, and inspector of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiazi, Prince Ji of Wuling was made Commander-in-Chief of military affairs for thirteen provinces including Yi and Liang, and inspector of Yi.

sentences.zh: 東魏丞相歡將兵二十萬自壺口趣蒲津，使高敖曹將兵三萬出河南。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Chancellor Huan was about to lead two hundred thousand troops from Hukou toward Puban Ford and sent Gao Aocao to lead thirty thousand out through Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei Chancellor Gao Huan was about to lead two hundred thousand troops from Hukou toward Puban Ford and sent Gao Aocao to lead thirty thousand out through Henan.

sentences.zh: 時關中饑，魏丞相泰所將將士不滿萬人，館谷於恆農五十餘日，聞歡將濟河，乃引兵入關，高敖曹遂圍恆農。

translations.literal: Guanzhong was then suffering famine; Wei Chancellor Tai's officers and soldiers numbered fewer than ten thousand. After lodging on grain at Hengnong for more than fifty days, hearing that Huan was about to cross the river, he led troops into the Pass; Gao Aocao thereupon besieged Hengnong.
translations.idiomatic: Guanzhong was then suffering famine; Wei Chancellor Yuwen Tai's officers and soldiers numbered fewer than ten thousand. After lodging on grain at Hengnong for more than fifty days, hearing that Gao Huan was about to cross the river, he led troops into the Pass; Gao Aocao thereupon besieged Hengnong.

sentences.zh: 歡右長史薛琡言於歡曰：「西賊連年饑饉，故冒死來入陝州，欲取倉粟。

translations.literal: Huan's Right Chief Clerk Xue Ju spoke to Huan, saying, "The western bandits have suffered famine year after year; therefore they risk death to enter Shaan and wish to seize granary grain.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan's Right Chief Clerk Xue Ju spoke to Huan, saying, "The western bandits have suffered famine year after year; therefore they risk death to enter Shaan and wish to seize granary grain, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 今敖曹已圍陝城，粟不得出。

translations.literal: Now Aocao has already besieged Shaan city and grain cannot come out.
translations.idiomatic: Now Aocao has already besieged Shaan city and grain cannot come out, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 但置兵諸道，勿與野戰，比及麥秋，其民自應餓死，寶炬、黑獺何憂不降！

translations.literal: Only place troops on the various routes and do not give battle in the field; by the time of the wheat harvest the people themselves should starve—what worry that Baoju and the Black Badger will not submit!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Only place troops on the various routes and do not give battle in the field; by the time of the wheat harvest the people themselves should starve—what worry that Emperor Wen and the Black Badger will not submit!

sentences.zh: 願勿渡河。

translations.literal: I beg that you not cross the river."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, I beg that you not cross the river."

sentences.zh: 」侯景曰：「今茲舉兵，形勢極大，萬一不捷，猝難收斂。

translations.literal: " Hou Jing said, "This campaign's momentum is extreme; if by chance it does not succeed, it will be hard to gather in abruptly.
translations.idiomatic: " Hou Jing said, "This campaign's momentum is extreme; if by chance it does not succeed, it will be hard to gather in abruptly, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 不如分為二軍，相繼而進，前軍若勝，後軍全力；

translations.literal: Better divide into two armies and advance in succession: if the forward army wins, the rear army gives its full strength;
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Better divide into two armies and advance in succession: if the forward army wins, the rear army gives its full strength;

sentences.zh: 前軍若敗，後軍承之。

translations.literal: if the forward army is defeated, the rear army takes over."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, if the forward army is defeated, the rear army takes over."

sentences.zh: 」歡不從，自蒲津濟河。

translations.literal: " Huan did not follow this and crossed the river himself from Puban.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Huan did not follow this and crossed the river himself from Puban.

sentences.zh: 丞相泰遣使戒華州刺史王羆，羆語使者曰：「老羆當道臥，貉子那得過！

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai sent an envoy to warn Huazhou inspector Wang Pi; Pi told the envoy, "Old Pi lies across the road—how can a badger get past!"
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Yuwen Tai sent an envoy to warn Huazhou inspector Wang Pi; Pi told the envoy, "Old Pi lies across the road—how can a badger get past!"

sentences.zh: 」歡至馮翊城下，謂羆曰：「何不早降！

translations.literal: Huan reached below Fengyi city and said to Pi, "Why not submit early!"
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan reached below Fengyi city and said to Pi, "Why not submit early!"

sentences.zh: 」羆大呼曰：「此城是王羆塚，死生在此。

translations.literal: Pi shouted loudly, "This city is Wang Pi's tomb; life and death are here.
translations.idiomatic: Pi shouted loudly, "This city is Wang Pi's tomb; life and death are here.

sentences.zh: 欲死者來！

translations.literal: Whoever wants to die, come!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Whoever wants to die, come!"

sentences.zh: 」歡知不可攻，乃涉洛，軍於許原西。

translations.literal: " Huan knew it could not be taken and forded the Luo, encamping west of Xuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Huan knew it could not be taken and forded the Luo, encamping west of Xuyuan.

sentences.zh: 泰至渭南，征諸州兵，皆未會。

translations.literal: Tai reached Weinan and summoned troops from the provinces; none had yet assembled.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai reached Weinan and summoned troops from the provinces; none had yet assembled.

sentences.zh: 欲進擊歡，諸將以眾寡不敵，請待歡更西以觀其勢。

translations.literal: He wished to advance and strike Huan; the generals, because they were few against many, asked to wait until Huan went farther west to observe his momentum.
translations.idiomatic: He wished to advance and strike Gao Huan; the generals, because they were few against many, asked to wait until Huan went farther west to observe his momentum.

sentences.zh: 泰曰：「歡若至長安，則人情大擾；

translations.literal: Tai said, "If Huan reaches Chang'an, popular sentiment will be greatly disturbed;
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai said, "If Gao Huan reaches Chang'an, popular sentiment will be greatly disturbed;

sentences.zh: 今及其遠來新至，可擊也。

translations.literal: now, while he has come from afar and is newly arrived, he can be struck."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, now, while he has come from afar and is newly arrived, he can be struck."

sentences.zh: 」即造浮橋於渭，令軍士繼三日糧，輕騎度渭，輜重自渭南夾渭而西。

translations.literal: He at once built a pontoon bridge on the Wei, ordered the soldiers three days' rations in succession, crossed the Wei with light horse, and had baggage train go west along both banks from Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: He at once built a pontoon bridge on the Wei, ordered the soldiers three days' rations in succession, crossed the Wei with light horse, and had baggage train go west along both banks from Weinan.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，壬辰，泰至沙苑，距東魏軍六十里。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen, Tai reached Shayuan, sixty li from the Eastern Wei army.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on renchen, Yuwen Tai reached Shayuan, sixty li from the Eastern Wei army.

sentences.zh: 諸將皆懼，宇文深獨賀。

translations.literal: The generals were all afraid; only Yuwen Shen congratulated him.
translations.idiomatic: The generals were all afraid; only Yuwen Shen congratulated him, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 泰問其故，對曰：「歡鎮撫河北，甚得眾心。

translations.literal: Tai asked the reason; he replied, "Huan has pacified and comforted Hebei and won the hearts of the masses greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai asked the reason; he replied, "Gao Huan has pacified and comforted Hebei and won the hearts of the masses greatly, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 以此自守，未易可圖。

translations.literal: With that to hold himself, he is not easy to plot against.
translations.idiomatic: With that to hold himself, he is not easy to plot against, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 今懸師渡河，非眾所欲，獨歡恥失竇泰，愎諫而來，所謂忿兵，可一戰擒也。

translations.literal: Now he has hung his army across the river—this is not what the masses desire; Huan alone is shamed at losing Dou Tai, obstinate against remonstrance in coming—what is called an angry army. He can be captured in one battle.
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Now he has hung his army across the river—this is not what the masses desire; Huan alone is shamed at losing Dou Tai, obstinate against remonstrance in coming—what is called an angry army. He can be captured in one battle, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 事理昭然，何為不賀！

translations.literal: The principle is clear as daylight—why not congratulate!
translations.idiomatic: The principle is clear as daylight—why not congratulate, the annals record!

sentences.zh: 願假深一節，發王羆之兵邀其走路，使無遺類。

translations.literal: I beg to borrow Shen one tally, to dispatch Wang Pi's troops to cut off their escape route and leave none surviving."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, I beg to borrow Shen one tally, to dispatch Wang Pi's troops to cut off their escape route and leave none surviving."

sentences.zh: 」泰遣須昌縣公達奚武覘歡軍，武從三騎，皆效歡將士衣服，日暮，去營數百步下馬，潛聽得其軍號，因上馬歷營，若警夜者，有不如法，往往撻之，具知敵之情狀而還。

translations.literal: " Tai sent Xuchang Duke Daxi Wu to reconnoiter Huan's army. Wu took three riders, all dressed like Huan's officers; at dusk, several hundred paces from the camp he dismounted, secretly listened and learned their army signals, then mounted and passed through the camp as if on night watch—where men were not by regulation he often flogged them—and returned knowing the enemy's condition in full.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuwen Tai sent Xuchang Duke Daxi Wu to reconnoiter Gao Huan's army. Wu took three riders, all dressed like Huan's officers; at dusk, several hundred paces from the camp he dismounted, secretly listened and learned their army signals, then mounted and passed through the camp as if on night watch—where men were not by regulation he often flogged them—and returned knowing the enemy's condition in full.

sentences.zh: 歡聞泰至，癸巳，引兵會之。

translations.literal: Huan heard Tai had arrived; on guisi he led troops to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan heard Yuwen Tai had arrived; on guisi he led troops to meet him.

sentences.zh: 候騎告歡兵且至，泰召諸將謀之。

translations.literal: Scouts reported that Huan's troops were about to arrive; Tai summoned the generals to plan.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts reported that Gao Huan's troops were about to arrive; Yuwen Tai summoned the generals to plan.

sentences.zh: 開府儀同三司李弼曰：「彼眾我寡，不可平地置陳，此東十里有渭曲，可先據以待之。

translations.literal: Director of the Palace Gate, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Li Bi said, "They are many and we few—we cannot set battle lines on level ground. Ten li east of here is the Wei bend; we can seize it first and wait."
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Palace Gate, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Li Bi said, "They are many and we few—we cannot set battle lines on level ground. Ten li east of here is the Wei bend; we can seize it first and wait."

sentences.zh: 」泰從之，背水東西為陳，李弼為右拒，趙貴為左拒，命將士皆偃戈於葦中，約聞鼓聲而起。

translations.literal: " Tai followed this, with backs to the water arrayed east and west; Li Bi was right refusal, Zhao Gui left refusal; he ordered officers and soldiers all to hide weapons in the reeds, with the agreement to rise at the sound of drums.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuwen Tai followed this, with backs to the water arrayed east and west; Li Bi was right refusal, Zhao Gui left refusal; he ordered officers and soldiers all to hide weapons in the reeds, with the agreement to rise at the sound of drums.

sentences.zh: 晡時，東魏兵至渭曲，都督太安斛律羌舉曰：「黑獺舉國而來，欲一死決，譬如猘狗，或能噬人。

translations.literal: In the hour before dusk Eastern Wei troops reached the Wei bend; Commandant Hulu Guangju of Tai'an said, "The Black Badger has brought the whole state to seek a fight to the death—like a mad dog, he may yet bite.
translations.idiomatic: In the hour before dusk Eastern Wei troops reached the Wei bend; Commandant Hulu Guangju of Tai'an said, "The Black Badger has brought the whole state to seek a fight to the death—like a mad dog, he may yet bite, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 且渭曲葦深土濘，無所用力，不如緩與相持，密分精銳徑掩長安，巢穴既傾，則黑獺不戰成擒矣。

translations.literal: Moreover the Wei bend has deep reeds and muddy soil—nowhere to exert force. Better to contend slowly and secretly divide picked troops to strike straight at Chang'an; once the nest is overturned, the Black Badger will be taken without battle."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Moreover the Wei bend has deep reeds and muddy soil—nowhere to exert force. Better to contend slowly and secretly divide picked troops to strike straight at Chang'an; once the nest is overturned, the Black Badger will be taken without battle."

sentences.zh: 」歡曰：「縱火焚之，何如？

translations.literal: Huan said, "What of setting fire and burning them?"
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan said, "What of setting fire and burning them?"

sentences.zh: 」侯景曰：「當生擒黑獺以示百姓，若眾中燒死，誰覆信之！

translations.literal: Hou Jing said, "We ought to take the Black Badger alive to show the common people; if he is burned to death in the crowd, who will believe it!"
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing said, "We ought to take the Black Badger alive to show the common people; if he is burned to death in the crowd, who will believe it!"

sentences.zh: 」彭樂盛氣請鬥，曰：「我眾賊寡，百人擒一，何憂不克！

translations.literal: " Peng Yue in high spirits asked to fight, saying, "We are many and the bandits few—a hundred men seize one—what worry that we cannot overcome!"
translations.idiomatic: " Peng Yue in high spirits asked to fight, saying, "We are many and the bandits few—a hundred men seize one—what worry that we cannot overcome!"

sentences.zh: 」歡從之。

translations.literal: " Huan followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Huan followed this, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 東魏兵望見魏兵少，爭進擊之，無復行列。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei troops saw Wei troops were few and vied to advance and attack, no longer keeping ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei troops saw Wei troops were few and vied to advance and attack, no longer keeping ranks.

sentences.zh: 兵將交，丞相泰鳴鼓，士皆奮起，於謹等六軍與之合戰，李弼等帥鐵騎橫擊之，東魏兵中絕為二，遂大破之。

translations.literal: As the armies were about to engage, Chancellor Tai beat the drums; the soldiers all leaped up. Yu Jin's six armies joined battle with them; Li Bi and others led iron horse in a flanking strike; Eastern Wei troops were cut in two in the middle and were greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: As the armies were about to engage, Chancellor Yuwen Tai beat the drums; the soldiers all leaped up. Yu Jin's six armies joined battle with them; Li Bi and others led iron horse in a flanking strike; Eastern Wei troops were cut in two in the middle and were greatly defeated.

sentences.zh: 李弼弟檦，身小而勇，每躍馬陷陳，隱身鞍甲之中，敵見皆曰：「避此小兒！

translations.literal: Li Bi's younger brother Biao, though small in body was brave; each time he leaped his horse into the formation he hid within saddle and armor; enemies who saw him all said, "Avoid this little boy!"
translations.idiomatic: Li Bi's younger brother Biao, though small in body was brave; each time he leaped his horse into the formation he hid within saddle and armor; enemies who saw him all said, "Avoid this little boy!"

sentences.zh: 」泰歎曰：「膽決如此，何必八尺之軀！

translations.literal: " Tai sighed, "With resolution like this, why need an eight-foot frame!"
translations.idiomatic: " Yuwen Tai sighed, "With resolution like this, why need an eight-foot frame!"

sentences.zh: 」征虜將軍武川耿令貴殺傷多，甲裳盡赤，泰曰：「觀其甲裳，足知令貴之勇，何必數級！

translations.literal: " Campaign-general Geng Linggui of Wuchuan killed and wounded many; his armor and garments were all red. Tai said, "Looking at his armor and garments is enough to know Linggui's bravery—why count heads!"
translations.idiomatic: " Campaign-general Geng Linggui of Wuchuan killed and wounded many; his armor and garments were all red. Yuwen Tai said, "Looking at his armor and garments is enough to know Linggui's bravery—why count heads!"

sentences.zh: 」彭樂乘醉深入魏陳，魏人刺之，腸出，內之復戰。

translations.literal: " Peng Yue, drunk, plunged deep into the Wei formation; Wei men stabbed him, his bowels came out, he tucked them back in and fought again.
translations.idiomatic: " Peng Yue, drunk, plunged deep into the Wei formation; Wei men stabbed him, his bowels came out, he tucked them back in and fought again.

sentences.zh: 丞相歡欲收兵更戰，使張華原以簿歷營點兵，莫有應者，還，白歡曰：「眾盡去，營皆空矣！

translations.literal: Chancellor Huan wished to gather troops and fight again; he sent Zhang Huayuan with registers to muster the camps and count soldiers—none answered. Returning, he told Huan, "The masses have all gone—the camps are empty!"
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Gao Huan wished to gather troops and fight again; he sent Zhang Huayuan with registers to muster the camps and count soldiers—none answered. Returning, he told Huan, "The masses have all gone—the camps are empty!"

sentences.zh: 」歡猶未肯去。

translations.literal: " Huan still would not leave.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Huan still would not leave.

sentences.zh: 阜城侯斛律金曰：「眾心離散，不可復用，宜急向河東！

translations.literal: Marquis of Fucheng Hulu Jin said, "Hearts are scattered and troops cannot be used again—you should hurry east to Hedong!"
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Fucheng Hulu Jin said, "Hearts are scattered and troops cannot be used again—you should hurry east to Hedong!"

sentences.zh: 」歡據鞍未動，金以鞭拂馬，乃馳去，夜，渡河，船去岸遠，歡跨橐駝就船，乃得渡。

translations.literal: " Huan gripped the saddle and did not move; Jin whipped the horse with his crop, and only then did he gallop away. At night he crossed the river; the boat was far from shore, and Huan straddled a Bactrian camel to reach the boat before he could cross.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Huan gripped the saddle and did not move; Jin whipped the horse with his crop, and only then did he gallop away. At night he crossed the river; the boat was far from shore, and Huan straddled a Bactrian camel to reach the boat before he could cross.

sentences.zh: 喪甲士八萬人，棄鎧仗十有八萬。

translations.literal: He lost eighty thousand armored soldiers and abandoned one hundred eighty thousand suits of armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: He lost eighty thousand armored soldiers and abandoned one hundred eighty thousand suits of armor and weapons.

sentences.zh: 丞相泰追歡至河上，選留甲士二萬餘人，餘悉縱歸。

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai pursued Huan to the river, selected and kept more than twenty thousand armored soldiers, and released the rest to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Yuwen Tai pursued Gao Huan to the river, selected and kept more than twenty thousand armored soldiers, and released the rest to return home.

sentences.zh: 都督李穆曰：「高歡破膽矣，速追之，可獲。

translations.literal: Commandant Li Mu said, "Gao Huan's courage is broken—pursue quickly and he can be taken."
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Li Mu said, "Gao Huan's courage is broken—pursue quickly and he can be taken."

sentences.zh: 」泰不聽，還軍渭南，所征之兵甫至，乃於戰所人種柳一株以旌武功。

translations.literal: Tai did not listen, returned the army to Weinan; the troops he had summoned had just arrived, and at the battlefield each man planted one willow to mark the martial achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai did not listen, returned the army to Weinan; the troops he had summoned had just arrived, and at the battlefield each man planted one willow to mark the martial achievement.

sentences.zh: 侯景言於歡曰：「黑獺新勝而驕，必不為備，願得精騎二萬，逕往取之。

translations.literal: Hou Jing spoke to Huan, saying, "The Black Badger is newly victorious and arrogant—he is sure not to be on guard. I beg two thousand picked horse to go straight and take him."
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing spoke to Gao Huan, saying, "The Black Badger is newly victorious and arrogant—he is sure not to be on guard. I beg two thousand picked horse to go straight and take him."

sentences.zh: 」歡以告婁妃，妃曰：「設如其言，景豈有還理！

translations.literal: " Huan told Lady Lou; the lady said, "Suppose his words are true—would Jing have any reason to return!
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Huan told Lady Lou; the lady said, "Suppose his words are true—would Jing have any reason to return!

sentences.zh: 得黑獺而失景，何利之有！

translations.literal: To gain the Black Badger and lose Jing—what profit is there!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, To gain the Black Badger and lose Jing—what profit is there!"

sentences.zh: 」歡乃止。

translations.literal: " Huan then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " Gao Huan then stopped, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 魏加丞相泰柱國大將軍，李弼等十二將皆進爵增邑有差。

translations.literal: Wei advanced Chancellor Tai to Pillar-of-State Grand General; Li Bi and eleven other generals all received enfeoffment and increased fiefs in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Wei advanced Chancellor Yuwen Tai to Pillar-of-State Grand General; Li Bi and eleven other generals all received enfeoffment and increased fiefs in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 高敖曹聞歡敗，釋恆農，退保洛陽。

translations.literal: Gao Aocao heard Huan was defeated, released Hengnong, and withdrew to hold Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Aocao heard Gao Huan was defeated, released Hengnong, and withdrew to hold Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，魏行台宮景壽等向洛陽，東魏洛州大都督韓賢擊走之。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Wei Mobile Headquarters Gong Jingshou and others advanced on Luoyang; Eastern Wei Luozhou Grand Commander Han Xian struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wei Mobile Headquarters Gong Jingshou and others advanced on Luoyang; Eastern Wei Luozhou Grand Commander Han Xian struck and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 州民韓木蘭作亂，賢擊破之。

translations.literal: A provincial commoner, Han Mulan, made rebellion; Xian defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial commoner, Han Mulan, made rebellion; Xian defeated him.

sentences.zh: 一賊匿屍間，賢自按檢收鎧仗，賊欻起斫之，斷脛而卒。

translations.literal: One bandit hid among the corpses; Xian personally searched and collected armor and weapons; the bandit suddenly rose and hacked him—his leg was severed and he died.
translations.idiomatic: One bandit hid among the corpses; Xian personally searched and collected armor and weapons; the bandit suddenly rose and hacked him—his leg was severed and he died.

sentences.zh: 魏復遣行台馮翊王季海與獨孤信將步騎二萬趣洛陽，洛州刺史李顯趣三荊，賀拔勝、李弼圍蒲板。

translations.literal: Wei again sent Mobile Headquarters Prince Ji of Fenyang and Dugu Xin to lead twenty thousand foot and horse toward Luoyang; Luozhou inspector Li Xian pressed the Three Jing; Heba Sheng and Li Bi besieged Puban.
translations.idiomatic: Wei again sent Mobile Headquarters Prince Ji of Fenyang and Dugu Xin to lead twenty thousand foot and horse toward Luoyang; Luozhou inspector Li Xian pressed the Three Jing; Heba Sheng and Li Bi besieged Puban.

sentences.zh: 東魏丞相歡之西伐也，蒲板民敬珍謂其從祖兄祥曰：「高歡迫逐乘輿，天下忠義之士皆欲剚刃於其腹。

translations.literal: When Eastern Wei Chancellor Huan marched west to attack, Puban commoner Jing Zhen spoke to his elder cousin's son Xiang, saying, "Gao Huan drives off the imperial carriage; loyal and righteous men under Heaven all wish to plunge blades into his belly.
translations.idiomatic: When Eastern Wei Chancellor Gao Huan marched west to attack, Puban commoner Jing Zhen spoke to his elder cousin's son Xiang, saying, "Gao Huan drives off the imperial carriage; loyal and righteous men under Heaven all wish to plunge blades into his belly, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 今又稱兵西上，吾欲與兄起兵斷其歸路，此千載一時也。

translations.literal: Now again he raises troops and goes west—I wish to rise with you and cut off his return route. This is a moment in a thousand years."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Now again he raises troops and goes west—I wish to rise with you and cut off his return route. This is a moment in a thousand years."

sentences.zh: 」祥從之，糾合鄉里，數日，有眾萬餘。

translations.literal: " Xiang followed him; they gathered the countryside, and within days had a host of more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiang followed him; they gathered the countryside, and within days had a host of more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 會歡自沙苑敗歸，祥、珍帥眾邀之，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: It happened that Huan returned defeated from Shayuan; Xiang and Zhen led the masses to intercept him and killed and captured in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Gao Huan returned defeated from Shayuan; Xiang and Zhen led the masses to intercept him and killed and captured in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 賀拔勝、李弼至河東，祥、珍帥猗氏等六縣十餘萬戶歸之，丞相泰以珍為平陽太守，祥為行台郎中。

translations.literal: Heba Sheng and Li Bi reached Hedong; Xiang and Zhen led more than one hundred thousand households of six counties including Yishi to submit to them. Chancellor Tai made Zhen administrator of Pingyang and Xiang Gentleman-inside-the-Palace of the Mobile Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Sheng and Li Bi reached Hedong; Xiang and Zhen led more than one hundred thousand households of six counties including Yishi to submit to them. Chancellor Yuwen Tai made Zhen administrator of Pingyang and Xiang Gentleman-inside-the-Palace of the Mobile Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 東魏秦州刺史薛崇禮守蒲板，別駕薛善，崇禮之族弟也，言於崇禮曰：「高歡有逐君之罪，善與兄忝衣冠緒餘，世荷國恩，今大軍已臨，而猶為高氏固守。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Qinzhou inspector Xue Chongli held Puban; Vice-Prefect Xue Shan was Chongli's clansman and spoke to Chongli, saying, "Gao Huan has the crime of driving off the ruler; Shan and my elder brother, as heirs of caps and robes, have received the state's grace for generations. Now the great army is at hand and yet we still hold firm for the Gao clan.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei Qinzhou inspector Xue Chongli held Puban; Vice-Prefect Xue Shan was Chongli's clansman and spoke to Chongli, saying, "Gao Huan has the crime of driving off the ruler; Shan and my elder brother, as heirs of caps and robes, have received the state's grace for generations. Now the great army is at hand and yet we still hold firm for the Gao clan, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 一旦城陷，函首送長安，署為逆賊，死有餘愧。

translations.literal: Once the city falls and our heads are boxed and sent to Chang'an, marked as traitors, death will still hold shame.
translations.idiomatic: Once the city falls and our heads are boxed and sent to Chang'an, marked as traitors, death will still hold shame, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 及今歸款，猶為愈也。

translations.literal: To submit in good time now would still be better."
translations.idiomatic: In sum, To submit in good time now would still be better."

sentences.zh: 」崇禮猶豫不決。

translations.literal: Chongli hesitated and could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Chongli hesitated and could not decide.

sentences.zh: 善與族人斬關納魏師，崇禮出走，追獲之。

translations.literal: Shan and his clansmen cut down the gate guards and admitted the Wei army; Chongli fled but was pursued and captured.
translations.idiomatic: Shan and his clansmen cut down the gate guards and admitted the Wei army; Chongli fled but was pursued and captured.

sentences.zh: 丞相泰進軍蒲板，略定汾、絳，凡薛氏預開城之謀者，皆賜五等爵。

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai advanced the army to Puban and pacified Fen and Jiang; all of the Xue clan who had taken part in opening the city were granted fifth-rank nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Yuwen Tai advanced the army to Puban and pacified Fen and Jiang; all of the Xue clan who had taken part in opening the city were granted fifth-rank nobility.

sentences.zh: 善曰：「背逆歸順，臣子常節，豈容闔門大小俱叨封邑！

translations.literal: Shan said, "Turning from rebellion to obedience is a minister's constant duty—how can the whole household, great and small, all receive fiefs!"
translations.idiomatic: Shan said, "Turning from rebellion to obedience is a minister's constant duty—how can the whole household, great and small, all receive fiefs!"

sentences.zh: 」與其弟慎固辭不受。

translations.literal: He and his younger brother Shen firmly declined and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: He and his younger brother Shen firmly declined and would not accept, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 東魏行晉州事封祖業棄城走，儀同三司薛修義追至洪洞，說祖業還守，祖業不從。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei acting Jinzhou affairs Feng Zuye abandoned the city and fled; Director of the Palace Gate, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Xue Xiuyi pursued to Hongtong and urged Zuye to return and hold the city; Zuye would not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei acting Jinzhou affairs Feng Zuye abandoned the city and fled; Director of the Palace Gate, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Xue Xiuyi pursued to Hongtong and urged Zuye to return and hold the city; Zuye would not follow.

sentences.zh: 修義還據晉州，安集固守。

translations.literal: Xiuyi returned and held Jinzhou, settling and comforting those who held firm.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuyi returned and held Jinzhou, settling and comforting those who held firm.

sentences.zh: 魏儀同三司長孫子彥引兵至城下，修義開門伏甲以待之。

translations.literal: Wei Director of the Palace Gate, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Changsun Ziyan led troops to the walls; Xiuyi opened the gates and set ambush with armor to await them.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Director of the Palace Gate, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Changsun Ziyan led troops to the walls; Xiuyi opened the gates and set ambush with armor to await them.

sentences.zh: 子彥不測虛實，遂退走。

translations.literal: Ziyan could not gauge truth or falsehood and withdrew and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun Ziyan could not gauge truth or falsehood and withdrew and fled.

sentences.zh: 丞相歡以修義為晉州刺史。

translations.literal: Chancellor Huan made Xiuyi Jinzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Gao Huan made Xiuyi Jinzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 獨孤信至新安，高敖曹引兵北度河。

translations.literal: Dugu Xin reached Xin'an; Gao Aocao led troops north across the river.
translations.idiomatic: Dugu Xin reached Xin'an; Gao Aocao led troops north across the river.

sentences.zh: 信逼洛陽，洛州刺史廣陽王湛棄城歸鄴，信遂據金墉城。

translations.literal: Xin pressed Luoyang; Luozhou inspector Prince Zhan of Guangyang abandoned the city and returned to Ye; Xin thereupon held Jinyong city.
translations.idiomatic: Xin pressed Luoyang; Luozhou inspector Prince Zhan of Guangyang abandoned the city and returned to Ye; Xin thereupon held Jinyong city.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝之西遷也，散騎常侍河東裴寬謂諸弟曰：「天子既西，吾不可以東附高氏。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu went west, Attendant-in-Ordinary Pei Kuan of Hedong told his younger brothers, "The Son of Heaven has gone west—we cannot turn east and attach ourselves to the Gao clan."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu went west, Attendant-in-Ordinary Pei Kuan of Hedong told his younger brothers, "The Son of Heaven has gone west—we cannot turn east and attach ourselves to the Gao clan."

sentences.zh: 」帥家屬逃於大石嶺。

translations.literal: He led his household and fled to Great Stone Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: He led his household and fled to Great Stone Ridge.

sentences.zh: 獨孤信入洛，乃出見之。

translations.literal: When Dugu Xin entered Luoyang, he came out to see him.
translations.idiomatic: When Dugu Xin entered Luoyang, he came out to see him.

sentences.zh: 時洛陽荒廢，人士流散，唯河東柳虯在陽城，裴諏之在穎川，信俱征之，以虯為行台郎中，諏之為開府屬。

translations.literal: Luoyang was then desolate and ruined; scholars and officials were scattered—only Liu Qiu of Hedong was in Yangcheng and Pei Xunzhi in Yingchuan; Xin summoned them both, making Qiu Gentleman-inside-the-Palace of the Mobile Headquarters and Xunzhi an aide in the Opening Office.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang was then desolate and ruined; scholars and officials were scattered—only Liu Qiu of Hedong was in Yangcheng and Pei Xunzhi in Yingchuan; Xin summoned them both, making Qiu Gentleman-inside-the-Palace of the Mobile Headquarters and Xunzhi an aide in the Opening Office.

sentences.zh: 東魏穎州長史賀若統執刺史田迄，舉城降魏，魏都督梁回入據其城。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Yingzhou Chief Clerk He Ruo Tong seized Yingzhou inspector Tian Qi and raised the city to submit to Wei; Wei Commandant Liang Hui entered and held the city.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei Yingzhou Chief Clerk He Ruo Tong seized Yingzhou inspector Tian Qi and raised the city to submit to Wei; Wei Commandant Liang Hui entered and held the city.

sentences.zh: 前通直散騎侍郎鄭偉起兵陳留，攻東魏梁州，執其刺史鹿永吉。

translations.literal: Former Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary Zheng Wei raised troops in Chenliu and attacked Eastern Wei Liangzhou, seizing its inspector Lu Yongji.
translations.idiomatic: Former Direct Attendant-in-Ordinary Zheng Wei raised troops in Chenliu and attacked Eastern Wei Liangzhou, seizing its inspector Lu Yongji.

sentences.zh: 前大司馬從事中郎崔彥穆攻滎陽，執其太守蘇淑，與廣州長史劉志皆降於魏。

translations.literal: Former Grand Marshal Staff Member Cui Yanmu attacked Xingyang and seized its administrator Su Shu; together with Guangzhou Chief Clerk Liu Zhi he all submitted to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Former Grand Marshal Staff Member Cui Yanmu attacked Xingyang and seized its administrator Su Shu; together with Guangzhou Chief Clerk Liu Zhi he all submitted to Wei.

sentences.zh: 偉，先護之子也。

translations.literal: Wei was a son of Xianhu.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wei was a son of Xianhu, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 丞相泰以偉為北徐州刺史，彥穆為滎陽太守。

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai made Wei Northern Xuzhou inspector and Yanmu administrator of Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Yuwen Tai made Wei Northern Xuzhou inspector and Yanmu administrator of Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月，東魏行台任祥帥督將堯雄、趙育、是雲寶攻穎川，丞相泰使大都督宇文貴、樂陵公遼西怡峰將步騎二千救之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Eastern Wei Mobile Headquarters Ren Xiang led supervising generals Yao Xiong, Zhao Yu, and Shi Yunbao to attack Yingchuan; Chancellor Tai sent Grand Commander Yuwen Gui and Duke of Yueling, Yiling, Yi Feng to lead two thousand foot and horse to rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Eastern Wei Mobile Headquarters Ren Xiang led supervising generals Yao Xiong, Zhao Yu, and Shi Yunbao to attack Yingchuan; Chancellor Yuwen Tai sent Grand Commander Yuwen Gui and Duke of Yueling, Yiling, Yi Feng to lead two thousand foot and horse to rescue it.

sentences.zh: 軍至陽翟，雄等軍已去穎川三十里，祥帥眾四萬繼其後。

translations.literal: The army reached Yangdi; Xiong and the others' army had already left Yingchuan thirty li; Xiang led forty thousand men following behind.
translations.idiomatic: The army reached Yangdi; Xiong and the others' army had already left Yingchuan thirty li; Xiang led forty thousand men following behind.

sentences.zh: 諸將鹹以為「彼眾我寡，不可爭鋒」。

translations.literal: The generals all thought, "They are many and we few—we cannot contend at the spear."
translations.idiomatic: The generals all thought, "They are many and we few—we cannot contend at the spear."

sentences.zh: 貴曰：「雄等謂吾兵少，必不敢進。

translations.literal: Gui said, "Xiong and the others think our troops few and are sure not to advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Gui said, "Xiong and the others think our troops few and are sure not to advance, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 彼與任祥合兵攻穎川，城必危矣。

translations.literal: If they join Ren Xiang's troops to attack Yingchuan, the city will be in peril.
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If they join Ren Xiang's troops to attack Yingchuan, the city will be in peril;

sentences.zh: 若賀若統陷沒，吾輩坐此何為！

translations.literal: If He Ruo Tong falls, what are we sitting here for!
translations.idiomatic: if He Ruo Tong falls, what are we sitting here for!

sentences.zh: 今進據穎川，有城可守，又出其不意，破之必矣！

translations.literal: Now advance and seize Yingchuan—we have a city to hold and also take them unawares; defeating them is certain!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, Now advance and seize Yingchuan—we have a city to hold and also take them unawares; defeating them is certain!"

sentences.zh: 」遂疾趨，據穎川，背城為陳以待。

translations.literal: He thereupon hurried forward, seized Yingchuan, and with backs to the city set battle lines to wait.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon hurried forward, seized Yingchuan, and with backs to the city set battle lines to wait.

sentences.zh: 雄等至，合戰，大破之。

translations.literal: When Xiong and the others arrived they joined battle and were greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiong and the others arrived they joined battle and were greatly defeated.

sentences.zh: 雄走，趙育請降，俘其士卒萬餘人，悉縱遣之。

translations.literal: Xiong fled; Zhao Yu asked to submit; they captured more than ten thousand of his officers and soldiers and released them all.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong fled; Zhao Yu asked to submit; they captured more than ten thousand of his officers and soldiers and released them all.

sentences.zh: 任祥聞雄敗，不敢進，貴與怡峰乘勝逼之，祥退保宛陵；

translations.literal: Ren Xiang heard Xiong was defeated and did not dare advance; Gui and Yi Feng took advantage of the victory to press him, and Xiang withdrew to hold Wanshan;
translations.idiomatic: Ren Xiang heard Xiong was defeated and did not dare advance; Gui and Yi Feng took advantage of the victory to press him, and Xiang withdrew to hold Wanshan;

sentences.zh: 貴追及，擊之，祥軍大敗。

translations.literal: Gui pursued and overtook him and struck; Xiang's army was greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Gui pursued and overtook him and struck; Xiang's army was greatly defeated.

sentences.zh: 是雲寶殺其陽州刺史那椿，以州降魏。

translations.literal: Shi Yunbao killed his Yangzhou inspector Na Chun and submitted the province to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yunbao killed his Yangzhou inspector Na Chun and submitted the province to Wei.

sentences.zh: 魏以貴為開府儀同三司，是雲寶、趙育為車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: Wei made Gui Director of the Palace Gate, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, and Shi Yunbao and Zhao Yu Grand Masters of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Wei made Yuwen Gui Director of the Palace Gate, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, and Shi Yunbao and Zhao Yu Grand Masters of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 都督杜陵韋孝寬攻東魏豫州，拔之，執其行台馮邕。

translations.literal: Commandant Wei Xiaokuan of Duling attacked Eastern Wei Yuzhou and took it, seizing its Mobile Headquarters Feng Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Wei Xiaokuan of Duling attacked Eastern Wei Yuzhou and took it, seizing its Mobile Headquarters Feng Yong.

sentences.zh: 孝寬名叔裕，以字行。

translations.literal: Xiaokuan's name was Shuyu; he went by his style.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaokuan's name was Shuyu; he went by his style, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 丙子，東魏以驃騎大將軍、儀同三司-{万俟}-普為太尉。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Eastern Wei made Flying Cavalry Grand General, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Moqi Pu Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Eastern Wei made Flying Cavalry Grand General, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Moqi Pu Grand Commander.

sentences.zh: 司農張樂皋等聘於東魏。

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Granaries Zhang Legao and others were sent on embassy to Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Imperial Granaries Zhang Legao and others were sent on embassy to Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 十二月，魏行台楊白駒與東魏陽州刺史段粲戰於蓼塢，魏師敗績。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wei Mobile Headquarters Yang Baiju battled Eastern Wei Yangzhou inspector Duan Can at Liaowu; the Wei army was badly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Wei Mobile Headquarters Yang Baiju battled Eastern Wei Yangzhou inspector Duan Can at Liaowu; the Wei army was badly defeated.

sentences.zh: 魏荊州刺史郭鸞攻東魏東荊州刺史清都慕容儼，儼晝夜拒戰二百餘日，乘間出擊鸞，大破之。

translations.literal: Wei Jingzhou inspector Guo Luan attacked Eastern Wei Eastern Jingzhou inspector Murong Yan of Qingdu; Yan day and night resisted battle for more than two hundred days, seized an opening to sally and strike Luan, and greatly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jingzhou inspector Guo Luan attacked Eastern Wei Eastern Jingzhou inspector Murong Yan of Qingdu; Yan day and night resisted battle for more than two hundred days, seized an opening to sally and strike Luan, and greatly defeated him.

sentences.zh: 時河南諸州多失守，唯東荊獲全。

translations.literal: At that time many provinces south of the river had fallen; only Eastern Jing was preserved whole.
translations.idiomatic: At that time many provinces south of the river had fallen; only Eastern Jing was preserved whole.

sentences.zh: 河間邢磨納、范陽盧仲禮、仲禮從弟仲裕等皆起兵海隅以應魏。

translations.literal: Xing Mo of Hejian, Lu Zhongli of Fanyang, and Zhongli's younger cousin Zhongyu all raised troops on the seacoast to respond to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Mo of Hejian, Lu Zhongli of Fanyang, and Zhongli's younger cousin Zhongyu all raised troops on the seacoast to respond to Wei.

sentences.zh: 東魏濟州刺史高季式有部曲千餘人，馬八百匹，鎧仗皆備。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Jizhou inspector Gao Jishi had a personal following of more than a thousand men, eight hundred horses, and armor and weapons all complete.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei Jizhou inspector Gao Jishi had a personal following of more than a thousand men, eight hundred horses, and armor and weapons all complete.

sentences.zh: 濮陽民杜靈椿等為盜，聚眾近萬人，攻城剽野。

translations.literal: Puyang commoner Du Lingchun and others were bandits, gathering a host of nearly ten thousand, attacking cities and plundering the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: Puyang commoner Du Lingchun and others were bandits, gathering a host of nearly ten thousand, attacking cities and plundering the countryside.

sentences.zh: 季式遣騎三百，一戰擒之，又擊陽平賊路文徒等，悉平之，於是遠近肅清。

translations.literal: Jishi sent three hundred horse; in one battle he captured them, and again struck the Yangping bandit Lu Wentu and others—all were pacified; then far and near were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Jishi sent three hundred horse; in one battle he captured them, and again struck the Yangping bandit Lu Wentu and others—all were pacified; then far and near were cleared.

sentences.zh: 或謂季式曰：「濮陽、陽平乃畿內之郡，不奉詔命，又不侵境，何急而使私軍遠戰！

translations.literal: Someone told Jishi, "Puyang and Yangping are commanderies within the capital region—they do not obey the court's orders and do not invade the borders; why hurry to send private troops on distant campaigns!
translations.idiomatic: Someone told Jishi, "Puyang and Yangping are commanderies within the capital region—they do not obey the court's orders and do not invade the borders; why hurry to send private troops on distant campaigns!

sentences.zh: 萬一失利，豈不獲罪乎！

translations.literal: If by chance you lose, will you not be punished!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, If by chance you lose, will you not be punished!"

sentences.zh: 」季式曰：「君何言之不忠也！

translations.literal: " Jishi said, "Sir, your words lack loyalty!
translations.idiomatic: " Jishi said, "Sir, your words lack loyalty!

sentences.zh: 我與國家同安共危，豈有見賊而不討乎！

translations.literal: I share security and danger with the state—how could I see bandits and not strike them!
translations.idiomatic: In sum, I share security and danger with the state—how could I see bandits and not strike them!

sentences.zh: 且賊知台軍猝不能來，又不疑外州有兵擊之，乘其無備，破之必矣。

translations.literal: Moreover the bandits know the court's army cannot come in haste and do not suspect troops from outer provinces will strike them; taking them unawares, defeat is certain.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the bandits know the court's army cannot come in haste and do not suspect troops from outer provinces will strike them; taking them unawares, defeat is certain, the annals record.

sentences.zh: 以此獲罪，吾亦無恨！

translations.literal: To be punished for this—I have no regret!"
translations.idiomatic: In sum, To be punished for this—I have no regret!"
